assertions.assertion: Registers the second database with AddStorage(storageInstanceId, storage => storage.AddPostgreSql(...))
Maps User Management to it with AddUserManagement(storageInstanceId, ...)
Migrates the named instance explicitly using IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory.GetStorageInstanceSchema(storageInstanceId, ct).MigrateAsync
Does NOT call AddStorage twice for the default instance (selecting a second provider for the same instance throws InvalidOperationException)
assertions.rationale: AddStorage for default instance appears once; second call uses the named instance, and notes duplicate default throws InvalidOperationException.
